entries.title: A review that read an earlier version no longer shows as a plain pass
entries.body: When a review passed and the change moved on afterwards, the merge card and a task's details now say the review passed at an earlier version, with an orange dot and the version it read, instead of a green pass. A review whose first try failed now reads the newest version when it starts again, so it no longer gets stuck on the version it was first given.
entries.noPicture: The review cell only changes when a pass is older than the version on offer, which needs a review and a later push that no shared journey stages for a hero picture.
